resource_keys.description: Canonical resource keys acquired atomically — all or none (PRD §7). Path-shaped keys may not contain '.' or '..' segments (no traversal past the claimed root). Keys are canonical (tools/peer_network/resource_keys.py): trimmed, single slashes, no trailing slash, no '.'/'..' segments. Two keys overlap when equal or when one path is an ancestor of the other; a claim never widens silently (scope_expansion).

status.description: Lifecycle of the lease. ACTIVE = held and working; BLOCKED = held, waiting on a human gate or dependency (protocol §2); LEASE_AT_RISK = renewal missed, stop before the next edit/push (PRD §8); RELEASED = given up (lost the race, handed back, stale takeover); COMPLETE = delivered and released (law 5).

claimed_at.description: When the claim was made, self-reported for the ledger (the lease's start). NOT the race's ordering key: the race is decided by the GitHub creation time / event id of the claim comment (protocol §2), which no session can back-date.
